_comment_globals: Typed globals on the RICH (per-component) shape: the only suite that emits `with<Global>` builder pipes, so it is what proves a pipe echoes its global's real input type (Bool / Int / Value Dir) instead of String.
_comment_variants: `_variants` on the RICH (per-component) shape. Both renderers and a NON-default
separator, so a hardcoded comma would show up as a golden diff.
Each variant claims its BASE attribute's capability row (`weightAsNumber` claims
`weight`), so no component's `Attrs` record grows a field — the same discipline as a
`_controlled` `default*` companion. This is HTML's own convention: the base keeps the
spec-correct type and the variant is the ergonomic alternative, exactly as
